lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm Kim Seoyeon, an activist at Hope Sharing.
lines.en: Hello. I called because I want to join in donating.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Which area are you interested in?
lines.learner: 국제적인 기아 문제와 국내 보육원에 관심이 있어요.
lines.en: I'm interested in global hunger and local orphanages.
lines.roman: gukjejeogin gia munjewa gungnae boyugwone gwansimi isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 현금과 물품 중 어떤 방식이 좋으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Which do you prefer, cash or goods?
lines.beaver_roman: hyeongeumgwa mulpum jung eotteon bangsigi joeuseyo?
lines.learner: 현금이 좋겠어요. 구제가 필요한 곳에 바로 쓰이니까요.
lines.en: Cash, I think. It goes straight to where relief is needed.
lines.roman: hyeongeumi jokesseoyo. gujega piryohan gose baro sseuinikkayo.

lines.beaver: 맞습니다. 요즘은 수재민 지원 요청도 많습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Lately there are many requests to help flood victims.
lines.beaver_roman: matseumnida. yojeumeun sujaemin jiwon yocheongdo manseumnida.
lines.learner: 지역을 막론하고 수재민을 돕는 건 인도적인 일이에요.
lines.en: Helping flood victims, regardless of region, is humanitarian.
lines.roman: jiyeogeul mangnonhago sujaemineul domneun geon indojeogin irieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Regular giving is also possible. What would you like to do?
lines.learner: 정기 후원으로 할게요. 부담이 없어서 좋네요.
lines.en: I'll do regular giving. I like that it's not a burden.
lines.roman: jeonggi huwoneuro halgeyo. budami eopseoseo jonneyo.

lines.beaver_en: May we publicly introduce your name as a donor?
lines.learner: 아니요. 받은 걸 사회에 환원하는 것뿐이에요.
lines.en: No. I'm just giving back to society what I received.
lines.roman: aniyo. badeun geol sahoee hwanwonhaneun geotppunieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Was there something that made you decide to donate?
lines.learner: 자본주의 사회는 각박해서 소외되는 사람이 많아요.
lines.en: Capitalist society is harsh, so many people are left out.
lines.roman: jabonjuui sahoeneun gakbakaeseo soedoeneun sarami manayo.

lines.beaver_en: That's why state support alone isn't enough.
lines.learner: 네, 제도적인 지원과 민간단체 봉사가 다 필요해요.
lines.en: Yes, we need both institutional support and NGO volunteering.
lines.roman: ne, jedojeogin jiwongwa mingandanche bongsaga da piryohaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Would you also be willing to volunteer?
lines.learner: 네. 귀천을 막론하고 누구나 이바지할 수 있잖아요.
lines.en: Yes. Anyone can contribute, regardless of status.
lines.roman: ne. gwicheoneul mangnonhago nuguna ibajihal su itjanayo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. I'll send the form by email.
lines.learner: 네, 감사합니다. 국민적인 동참이 늘었으면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: Thank you. I hope nationwide participation grows.
lines.roman: ne, gamsahamnida. gungminjeogin dongchami neureosseumyeon jokesseoyo.
